root_cause: Queen background agents (A2A heartbeat, SSE stream, self-improvement audit) were owned by ChatViewModel, so any conversation switch or panel lifecycle event risked cancelling them. ViewModels must never own process-scoped background work.
fix_pattern: Introduce an app-level @MainActor QueenBackgroundService singleton that owns A2A registration/heartbeat/stream and the audit loop. Decouple A2AMessageRouter via an A2AMessageRouterDelegate protocol so the router can feed any UI or service. Wire ChatViewModel as a weak delegate for live Queen-chat updates. Configure and start/stop the service in AppDelegate.
lessons: Never host long-lived background agents inside a ViewModel; use an app-level singleton with Task-based loops.
Decouple network routers from UI via delegate protocols so the same router can serve a service and a view.
After rebuilding trios.app, always kill the old process and relaunch with `open trios.app` to keep the menu-bar logo alive.
